new_result.statement: For an invertible indefinite physical pair B with D=|det B| and kappa=sigma_min(B), if a physical Schur-residual row has off-diagonal linear form with marginal density cap M, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 33 sqrt(M/kappa)[1+log_+(kappa/(MD))]. The row diagonal may vanish and the remaining residual may depend arbitrarily on that linear form.
new_result.physical_row_corollary: Taking M=sqrt(2)/sigma for Schur-row off-diagonal norm sigma>0 gives 33*2^(1/4)(kappa sigma)^(-1/2)[1+log_+(sigma/(sqrt(2)||B||op))].
new_result.integrated_fourier: Branchwise L2_t by Plancherel; universal unweighted L1_t remains OPEN.
